newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 534,400 MT slid 29 percent below the prior week and 37 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for the Netherlands (175,200 MT), Taiwan (168,300 MT), Spain (81,800 MT), unknown destinations (44,400 MT), and France (42,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for South Korea (162,000 MT).

Exports of 1,068,200 MT--exceeded the previous record high of 1,056,800 MT set the week ending Nov. 4, 1979--were 9 percent above the previous week and 14 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were China (226,800 MT), Japan (146,900 MT), the Netherlands (144,600 MT), Taiwan (139,600 MT), and Mexico (86,900 MT).
Note: Accumulated exports through the week ending Nov. 21 were adjusted by 35,600 MT, reducing China and increasing Malaysia.
